content:
deploy-bot: RC created: rc-hotfix-2026-03-21-1
deploy-bot: repo=infra/serve, head=8f3b7c2, author=@olivia, artifacts=[serve:2026.03.21+hotfix], promo-window=2026-03-21T22:00Z..23:00Z
olivia: created this RC to fix kv-cache eviction on long sessions. tagging @mira @ash for QA + oncall visibility. pls review release note delta. :eyes:
sam: quick check — does this include the runtime kernel bump? I see the build includes kernel v2.1.3 patch in the changelog. that could affect latency SLOs.
mira: canQA — i'll run the smoke suite now but heads-up we saw a flaky kv-warm test on staging earlier, might block promo.
ash (deploy-bot): running smoke: ./scripts/smoke.sh --suite=smoke-core --rc=rc-hotfix-2026-03-21-1
mira: smoke started. i'll paste failures if any.
ash (deploy-bot): smoke logs: 3 tests failed in kv-warm path, error=timeout on get_kv_range, stacktrace attached to artifact 8f3b7c2/logs/smoke-03
olivia: hmm that's the same flaky. can we darklaunch the feature flag instead of full promo? prefer to avoid rollback if possible.
ash (deploy-bot): promo window currently 22:00Z. suggestion from ops: do a staged promo (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with kv-cache TTL extension on canary.
ash (ash): +1 on staged. also propose pinning the model of the runtime to previous quantized artifact to reduce risk. command to pin: `rb pin serve --artifact=serve:2026.03.18-stable`
sam: OK to pin if it keeps latency stable, but that defeats the hotfix for kv eviction if the fix is only in head build. what's the delta?
mira: release note delta: "Fix kv-cache eviction causing 500s on >30m sessions (staging repro)." only in head. if we pin we lose fix. tradeoff: partial rollout + feature-flag = safest.
leo: product side preference: minimize customer-facing errors. partial rollout + darklaunch seems fine. confirm rollback plan if canary fails.
ash (ash): rollback playbook:
```
rb rollback rc-hotfix-2026-03-21-1 --to=serve:2026.03.18-stable
notify --channel=incidents --msg="rollback executed: rc-hotfix-2026-03-21-1 -> 2026.03.18-stable"
```

ash: also we should prepare postmortem checklist if canary shows increased 5xx or latency regression >2x. set alert thresholds.
sam: I'll add a temporary routing rule: canary-tag=hotfix-canary; traffic=5% for first 15m then evaluate metrics (5xx, p50/p95).
mira: QA will run kv-warm acceptance against canary instances and validate fix remains. i'll report within 20m of canary start.
olivia: timeline: 21:40Z — KV warm precharge on staging; 22:00Z — begin 5% canary; 22:15Z — evaluate; 22:30Z — 25% if green; 22:50Z — final push to 100% if still green.
leo: do we need release notes published for customers? small bullet in status page if we promote.
olivia: yes, I'll draft a short blurb: "Resolved intermittent session 500s caused by kv-cache eviction; gradual rollout in progress." keep it conservative.
ash (deploy-bot): canary plan scheduled. executing kv precharge job: `jobs/kv_precharge --pattern=session:* --parallel=50`
mira: precharge completed on staging, 0/3 flaky tests repro now. ready to start canary when you are.
ash (ash): starting canary 5% now. tagging: hotfix-canary-01
olivia: monitoring p95 & errors. please paste quick graphs.
sam: graphs show p95 stable, errors at baseline for first 4 minutes.
mira: QA smoke on canary passed for kv-warm path.
ash (ash): canary -> 25% now.
leo: thumbs if go to 100 after 25% hold? :thumbsup:
olivia: +1
sam: +1
mira: +1
ash (deploy-bot): 25% hold window complete. metrics: p95 +4%, 5xx unchanged. proceeding to 100% push now per policy.
ash (deploy-bot): promotion complete: rc-hotfix-2026-03-21-1 -> prod; artifacts served: serve:2026.03.21+hotfix
olivia: posting release notes update to status page and slack.
leo: thanks team. if anything spikes, we execute rollback playbook. otherwise we close RC and tag release notes final. :party:
mira: closing QA: no regressions observed in canary or post-promo quick checks.
ash (deploy-bot): RC closed and archived. changelog link: https://internal.changelog/rc-hotfix-2026-03-21-1
olivia: follow-up action: run a 6-hour perf sweep tomorrow morning to ensure no long-tail regressions. assigning to @sam.
sam: got it, scheduling perf-sweep at 08:00Z.
leo: noted for customer comms tomorrow morning.
ash (deploy-bot): Note: if any rollback triggered, reopen thread and update thread_ts.
